descriptions.w3d_s4_text_edit_construct: Constructs the text-entry widget and initializes its held interfaces and strings.
descriptions.w3d_s4_text_edit_destroy: Releases text-entry strings and held interfaces before invoking the base destructor.
descriptions.w3d_s4_text_edit_initialize_cursor: Subscribes cursor input, initializes cursor state and loads the configured cursor sound.
